ios.desc:
Introducing Kuri - the climate-friendly cooking app that makes meal planning, meal prepping and grocery shopping a breeze. With Kuri, you'll never have to worry about what to make for dinner or what ingredients to buy at the grocery store again. Here's why you'll love Kuri:
  
PERSONALIZED WHOLE FOODS RECIPES
Create a tailored experience based on your dietary preferences and cooking level. Whether you're looking for vegan, gluten-free, low-carb, whole foods, or just a good old-fashioned home-cooked meal, Kuri has you covered.

IN SEASON RECIPES
Kuri features recipes that are in season near you, ensuring fresh and delicious seasonal ingredients every time.

MAGIC MEAL PLANNING
Kuri plans out your meals for the week and creates a shopping list. Save time and money by using up what you already have on hand.

AI RECIPE IMPORT
Import recipes magically with artificial intelligence from websites, blogs, cookbooks, or social media. Add them to your meal plans, shopping list, and weekly cooking rotation without typing anything.

COOK WITH WHAT’S IN YOUR FRIDGE
Add what you have at home, and Kuri will create a meal plan using those ingredients.

FAMILY MODE
Sync your Kuri app across devices within your family. Share grocery lists, recipes, ingredients in your fridge, meal plans, and more, making Kuri the kitchen operating system for your household.

SHARED SHOPPING LISTS
Create and share shopping lists based on the meals and recipes you want to cook. Organized by aisle for easy and fast grocery shopping.

SYNCHRONIZATION ACROSS DEVICES
Access your favorite recipes, meal plans, and shopping lists no matter where you are.

NEW SEASONAL RECIPES EVERY MONTH
Enjoy new recipes featuring seasonal ingredients, prioritizing quality over quantity.

CLIMATE-FRIENDLY BADGE
See the carbon footprint (CO2 emissions) of each recipe, making Kuri the first app to show you how sustainable and climate-friendly a recipe is.

MEDITERRANEAN DIET MADE EASY
Discover new Mediterranean meals that are both healthy & delicious!

KURI PREMIUM
Kuri offers a subscription for unlimited access to premium features like Family Mode, AI Recipe Import, Nutrition info and new recipes every month. Experience Kuri Premium and elevate your meal planning and cooking experience.

In summary, Kuri offers:

→ Personalized recipes adapted to your dietary preferences and cooking level
→ Recipes that are in season near you
→ Family Mode
→ AI Recipe Import
→ Meal planning and shopping list features
